patch.value: Refuse incomplete list-all envelopes before rendering a Gantt chart

fetchItems currently trusts parsed.items and even treats a missing items field as an empty workspace. A truncated, paginated, unreadable, field-omitted, budget-compacted, count-mismatched, or malformed pm list-all response can therefore render a partial chart and report success. Request a full unbounded strict read and validate the entire 2026.8.17 list envelope before returning any rows.

The list-all invocation explicitly requests strict, full, unbounded output; a current real pm 2026.8.17 envelope is accepted; every incomplete or unverifiable envelope fails with CommandError before rendering; count, total, item length, and item identity agree; command and exporter both inherit the guard; release:check and a fresh installed-extension acceptance pass
Clean main checkout, no open package PR, companion item pm-cli-website-tv05 identifies this exact current-source gap
